# Source and quotation check 1

Source: `/private/var/folders/cs/vgp_x_353zd9frkjpysp7zdw0000gn/T/kntnt-native-session-8t7xxu2f/work/source.md`
Draft: `/private/var/folders/cs/vgp_x_353zd9frkjpysp7zdw0000gn/T/kntnt-native-session-8t7xxu2f/scratch/write-source-check.rkt4lp8v/draft.md`

The complete supplied source and complete current draft were read. This report assesses source support and the two translated spoken quotations. It does not perform a general editorial or mechanical review.

## Complete claim accounting

1. **Title: “Elm Quay samlar reparationsanmälningar i en logg”.** Source: “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings”; “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered.” The title names the customer, reports and common log. The source specifies two buildings and a trial. The title does not give the building count, but the lead says “prövade” and the opening dates the decision. In this case-study context its present tense can function as narrative present, without claiming that all 640 flats were covered or that post-trial use is known. No finding.

2. **Lead: “Kundens egna kategorier”.** Source: “The maintenance team designed its categories”; quotation: “The categories were ours; Svale helped us put them into the log.” The customer's ownership/design is preserved. The customer's institution is the actor in the draft, as requested by the brief: “The customer, Elm Quay Housing, should remain the acting party.” No finding.

3. **Lead: “fortsatt telefonkontakt med boende”.** Source: “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents”; “Previously telephone reports and emails were stored separately.” Telephone reporting is a form of telephone contact, and keeping that reporting channel open entails continuing that contact opportunity. The draft does not claim all telephone communications or a new service. No finding.

4. **Lead: “satte ramarna när Elm Quay Housing prövade Svale Systems”.** Source: “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings”; “It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair”; “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.” The supplier's name stands metonymically for its supplied log. The framing is the author's synthesis of the customer's implementation choices, not an assertion that either choice caused a measured result. No finding.

5. **Lead: “För andra bostadsbolag visar försöket vad som behöver förberedas och varför resultaten måste läsas med sina förbehåll.”** Source: “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts”; “The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.” This is the author's prospective lesson from the supported preparation experience and measurement limitations. It does not assert an observed result across other companies or make Lind recommend the supplier universally. No finding.

6. **Byline: “Av Thomas Barregren”.** Per the checker's supplied context, this is the invoking user's identity and is authorized independently of the material. Its absence from the source is not a finding.

7. **Opening: “I september 2025 beslutade Elm Quay Housings egen underhållsgrupp att prova en gemensam reparationslogg.”** Source: “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.” Month, year, actor, ownership, decision, trial and shared repair log are preserved. The draft omits the two-building count but does not replace it with a greater count or a company-wide trial claim. No finding.

8. **“Bostadsbolaget förvaltar 640 lägenheter”.** Source: “Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats.” Same institution, present management relation, number and units. No finding.

9. **“hade tidigare lagrat telefonanmälningar och mejl var för sig”.** Source: “Previously telephone reports and emails were stored separately.” Same report channels, separation and earlier period. The institutional subject is resolved by the supplied customer setting. No finding.

10. **“Gruppen ville att personal på olika arbetspass skulle kunna se samma information.”** Source: “The team wanted staff on different shifts to see the same information.” Desire is retained; the draft does not claim achieved access or complete adoption. No finding.

11. **Heading: “Kunden behåller telefonanmälan”.** Source: “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.” In the surrounding dated trial account, this labels the continuing reporting option during the change. It does not supply an independent claim about a later closure or current policy. No finding.

12. **“Gruppen valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation.”** Source: “It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair.” Same actor, supplier, preceding test, question tested and repair-level scope. “Efter” preserves chronology and does not add a causal reason beyond the source. No finding.

13. **“Det finns inget underlag för en jämförelse med någon annan leverantör.”** Source: “No comparison with another supplier is available.” A comparison being unavailable and a basis for making a comparison being absent are different claims. This is finding S1 below.

14. **“Underhållsgruppen utformade kategorierna”.** Source: “The maintenance team designed its categories.” Same agent and work. No finding.

15. **“och höll telefonanmälan öppen för de boende”.** Source: “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.” Same agent, channel, beneficiaries and continuation. No finding.

16. **“Svale konfigurerade loggen”.** Source: “Svale configured the log and trained six staff during two sessions.” Same supplier and implementation task. No finding.

17. **“och utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen”.** Source: “Svale configured the log and trained six staff during two sessions.” Six people and two training occasions/sessions are retained. Nothing asserts two full days or six people at each session. No finding.

18. **First quotation: “Vi lade mer tid på att enas om kategorierna än på att registrera de första anmälningarna.”** Source: “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports.” The group's first-person plural perspective, retrospective comparison, the category-agreement task and first reports are retained. No cost or clock-time figure is introduced. No finding; translation checked separately below.

19. **First quotation: “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa hus börjar använda loggen”.** Source: “I would set that time aside before the next building starts.” First-person singular, conditional recommendation, the previously identified preparation time and next-building timing are retained. In this package “starts” refers to the next building joining the log trial; the draft makes the log-use referent explicit without introducing a start date or claiming expansion already happened. No finding; translation checked separately below.

20. **Attribution: “skriver arbetsledaren för underhåll Maya Lind i en mejlintervju”.** Source: “Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, complete usable quotations”; “All interviews occurred by email, and no physical scene, emotion or remembered dialogue is provided.” Same named speaker, maintenance supervisory role and email medium. “Skriver” properly fits that medium. No scene or emotion is invented. No finding.

21. **Heading: “Försöksanteckningen avgränsar resultatet”.** Source: “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial”; “The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.” The heading summarizes the exclusions and explicit interpretation limit recorded by the document. No finding.

22. **“Elm Quays interna försöksanteckning, daterad den 4 december 2025”.** Source: “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025”. Same document, customer ownership, internal status and date. “Daterad” reasonably renders the supplied dated document designation without adding a publication event. No finding.

23. **“redovisar 31 registrerade reparationsanmälningar under de åtta veckorna”.** Source: “The trial lasted eight weeks. Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial.” Same duration, report count and document attribution. The eight weeks are the trial duration, not claimed to run from the September decision to the December note. No evaluative characterization of the count is added. No finding.

24. **“Akuta ärenden och arbete som beställts före försöket ingår inte.”** Source: “It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial.” Both exclusions remain attached to the recorded trial count. “Akuta ärenden” names emergency repair cases in this maintenance context; it does not identify all unfinished work or all work ordered during the trial. No finding.

25. **“Mediantiden från anmälan till tilldelning var två arbetsdagar under försöket, jämfört med tre under den föregående åttaveckorsperioden.”** Source: “Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period.” Statistic, start/end events, working-day units, values and comparison period are unchanged. “Tilldelning” does not become completion. I september 2025 beslutade Elm Quay Housings egen underhållsgrupp att prova en gemensam reparationslogg. Bostadsbolaget förvaltar 640 lägenheter och hade tidigare lagrat telefonanmälningar och mejl var för sig. Gruppen ville att personal på olika arbetspass skulle kunna se samma information.

- “Nästa hus,” “fler hus,” “logg,” “anteckningen” and other noun agreement convey grammatical genders only.

- The titles' narrative present refers to the source trial in context; it does not assert newly verified conditions in October 2026. A later policy change would not contradict the historical case heading.
- “Telefonkontakt” could denote a wider service in isolation, but here the following body explicitly identifies the retained telephone-reporting route. Conversely, telephone reporting is telephone contact. No separate service or actual call frequency is claimed.
- “Prövade Svale Systems” could describe another kind of supplier test in isolation, but here it denotes the explicitly described repair log. No other tested object is introduced.
- “Nästa hus börjar använda loggen” is a settled contextual rendering of the next building's start in this building-based log trial. An unrelated construction start is not the referent supplied by this material.

- The clarification of what time was measured does not deny the explicit report count. A trial that counted reports and measured assignment time satisfies both passages.
- The omitted two-building count introduces no contrary count or whole-portfolio assertion. The narrower no-more-buildings statement is entailed by the source's no-expansion statement and does not assert another expansion took place.
- The first supplied quotation is unused. That omission neither fabricates speech nor removes a qualification from either quotation actually used.

No additional factual, attributed or implied claim was identified beyond those accounted for above. The draft supplies no cost-saving claim, satisfaction result, completion-time improvement, supplier comparison result, physical scene, emotion or claim of independent journalism. The customer reservation survives.

Kundens egna kategorier och fortsatt telefonkontakt med boende satte ramarna när Elm Quay Housing prövade Svale Systems. För andra bostadsbolag visar försöket vad som behöver förberedas och varför resultaten måste läsas med sina förbehåll.

Av Thomas Barregren

I september 2025 beslutade Elm Quay Housings egen underhållsgrupp att prova en gemensam reparationslogg. Bostadsbolaget förvaltar 640 lägenheter och hade tidigare lagrat telefonanmälningar och mejl var för sig. Gruppen ville att personal på olika arbetspass skulle kunna se samma information.

## Kunden behåller telefonanmälan

Gruppen valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation. Någon jämförelse med en annan leverantör finns inte tillgänglig.

Underhållsgruppen utformade kategorierna och höll telefonanmälan öppen för de boende. Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen.

## Försöksanteckningen avgränsar resultatet

Elm Quays interna försöksanteckning, daterad den 4 december 2025, redovisar 31 registrerade reparationsanmälningar under de åtta veckorna. Akuta ärenden och arbete som beställts före försöket ingår inte.

Försöket har ännu inte utökats till fler hus. Gruppen ska först kontrollera hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer och därefter fatta beslut.
